OCR confused '1' with '7' at the start of the amount."},{"filename":"077.jpg","field":"total_amount","predicted":"23.26","issue":"Picked pre-rounding 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' instead of final 'TOTAL: 23.25' after rounding adjustment."},{"filename":"078.jpg","field":"total_amount","predicted":"","issue":"Empty string written instead of null when extraction failed; also missed GRAND TOTAL 92.80 on Thai Delicious receipt."},{"filename":"034.jpg","field":"date","predicted":"2018-08-09","issue":"Date mis-parsed as DD/MM reversed. Receipt date '09/03/2018' should be 2018-03-09, agent output 2018-08-09 — digit confusion 3↔8 from OCR."}],"root_causes":[{"id":"rc1","summary":"Priority tiering ignores final rounded TOTAL line that appears AFTER a 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' line; current logic takes first keyword match top-to-bottom and stops.","evidence":"077.jpg returned 23.26 (pre-rounding) instead of the subsequent 'TOTAL: 23.25' line."},{"id":"rc2","summary":"Null-handling writes empty string instead of real null when amount extraction fails.","evidence":"078.jpg has total_amount='' (empty string) rather than null; feedback marks amount_correct=false."},{"id":"rc3","summary":"No OCR digit-confusion mitigation / sanity cross-check against subtotal+tax or against repeated TOTAL/CASH lines; single OCR pass is trusted.","evidence":"074.jpg: 102.00 misread as 702.00 — the same amount appears multiple times on receipt (Subtotal 102.00, Total Incl 102.00, Payment 102.00) and a majority-vote or multi-pass OCR would have caught the misread."},{"id":"rc4","summary":"Date parser does not try both DD/MM/YYYY and MM/DD/YYYY and does not sanity-check month<=12 against OCR character confusion.","evidence":"034.jpg '09/03/2018' became 2018-08-09 — a '3' was OCR'd as '8' and parser accepted it without re-OCRing or validating."},{"id":"rc5","summary":"Skill files for image-ocr and xlsx do not spell out receipt-specific rules (priority tiers, exclusion list, two-line fallback, 'last matching keyword wins when final/rounded total follows', null vs empty cell, string-dtype for total_amount) nor cross-field consistency checks.","evidence":"Original image-ocr skill is generic OCR with no field-extraction guidance; xlsx skill is finance-oriented, no mention of preserving string decimals or writing None as empty cell."}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Lacks receipt field-extraction procedure: no priority tier list, no exclusion keywords, no two-line fallback, no multi-pass consensus for high-stakes numeric fields, no 'prefer last matching rounded TOTAL' rule when multiple TOTAL lines exist."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No guidance on date normalization for ambiguous formats (DD/MM vs MM/DD), no validation that parsed month<=12 and day<=31, no retry with alternative OCR pass when parse fails sanity check."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No preprocessing recipe tuned for receipts (grayscale + autocontrast + upscale <1500px + PSM 6 as primary) specified as the default pipeline."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"Does not document that for text-like numeric fields (e.g., '47.70') one must store as string with object dtype and format BEFORE writing, and that failed fields must be written as Python None (empty cell), not '' or 'None' or NaN."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"No pattern for 'single-sheet, exact-named sheet, no index column, filename-sorted rows' output contract."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'Structured Receipt Field Extraction' section with: (a) explicit PRIORITY_TIERS list (GRAND TOTAL > TOTAL RM / TOTAL: RM > TOTAL AMOUNT > NETT TOTAL / NET TOTAL / TOTAL DUE / AMOUNT DUE / BALANCE DUE / TOTAL / AMOUNT); (b) EXCLUSIONS list; (c) rule: when the same tier matches multiple lines, prefer the LAST match that follows any 'rounding adjustment' or 'rounded' line; (d) two-line fallback taking the last number on the next non-empty line; (e) number normalization stripping RM/$/commas; (f) a format_amount helper returning f'{v:.2f}' or None."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'Date Extraction and Normalization' section: try ISO, DD/MM/YYYY, MM/DD/YYYY, '%d %b %Y', '%d %B %Y'; validate 1 <= month <= 12 and 1 <= day <= 31 and 1990 <= year <= 2100; if ambiguous between DD/MM and MM/DD, prefer DD/MM (common on Malaysian receipts) but reject if resulting month > 12; return None if parse+validate fails."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'Default Receipt Preprocessing Pipeline': grayscale → autocontrast → upscale 2× when max(width,height)<1500 → OCR with --psm 6 as primary, fallback to multi_pass_ocr across PSM 4/6/11 when text empty or when sanity check fails."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'Cross-Check and Retry' rule: after extracting total, if the receipt text contains multiple occurrences of a numeric value that disagrees with the chosen total by only one digit, re-run OCR with alternative preprocessing (sharpen, invert, different PSM) and take majority value."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add explicit 'Critical Rules' and 'Common Pitfalls' subsections listing: exclusions-first, priority-order, two-line fallback, strip currency and commas, None (not '') on failure, string formatting of amount, filename lexicographic sort, per-image try/except to None instead of aborting the batch."},{"target_skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a 'Writing Tabular OCR Results' section covering: single named sheet, no index column, column-order enforcement, use object dtype for string-formatted numerics (e.g., total_amount='47.70'), write Python None for missing values so cells are empty, sort rows by filename as strings before writing."},{"target_skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a 'Common Output-Contract Pitfalls' subsection: avoid float coercion of two-decimal strings; avoid writing 'None'/'nan' text; verify sheet name matches spec exactly; verify no extra sheets."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a reusable end-to-end 'process_receipts(img_dir, out_xlsx)' pipeline example that composes preprocessing, extract_date, extract_total, format_amount, and writes to Excel with the correct schema — generalizable to any receipt-to-table task."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add Quality Self-Check checklist specific to batch receipt extraction (all files processed, filename sort, ISO date or None, two-decimal string or None, exclusions respected, priority tiers respected, per-image failures degrade to None)."}],"confidence":{"observed_failures":"high","root_causes":"high","skill_defects":"high","repair_recommendations":"medium"}}
